dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature with a smooth falcate arc from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is acute and narrow with a minimal pixel radius, forming a sharp terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin shows a steep convex slope, approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the visible body segment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1, representing a near-equilateral ratio between the maximum visible base width and total vertical pixel height.

other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse light-colored speckling and tonal mottling are present across the lower lateral surface of the dorsal fin.
